slices.title: Define passage lifecycle states
slices.summary: Added direction-independent ordinary, latch, scrub, terminal, and release passage phases with fail-closed timeline validation.

slices.title: Add usable viewport projection
slices.summary: Added fail-closed usable viewport authority with explicit persistent top and bottom insets.

slices.title: Derive shared text and graph anchors
slices.summary: Default text 35 percent and graph-center 50 percent anchors now share one usable viewport authority.

slices.title: Derive simultaneous latch offset
slices.summary: Synchronized latch geometry now derives stage top and prose document offset from shared anchors and stage size.

slices.title: Encode boundary salience policy
slices.summary: Added fail-closed direction-independent boundary cue salience policy.

slices.title: Model one local stage assembly
slices.summary: Added a local stage assembly projection with invariant divider and boundary spacing.

slices.title: Restore ordinary progressive layout
slices.summary: Progressive two-column CSS now exposes graph and prose from one static latch geometry without changing enhanced behavior.

slices.title: Cache viewport and chrome measurements
slices.summary: Cached CSS viewport ratios and persistent chrome insets at layout invalidation; scroll projections consume an immutable geometry snapshot with no per-frame computed-style reads.

slices.title: Implement synchronized entry latch
slices.summary: Enhanced two-column layout now derives prose offset and stage top from one cached synchronized latch; graph center settles at 50 percent while prose settles at 35 percent on the same tick.

slices.title: Gate motion until post-latch travel
slices.summary: Scroll motion remains at exact semantic zero through the shared latch, begins on the first post-latch pixel, and returns continuously to zero under reverse scroll.

slices.title: Preserve assembly spacing
slices.summary: Graph, vertical divider, prose latch, and bottom release boundary now consume one local assembly projection and preserve their meeting geometry through release.

slices.title: Preserve first cue endpoint
slices.summary: The opening cue is explicitly full-opacity document text before entry and returns to the existing internal salience projection at the shared latch.

slices.title: Preserve final cue endpoint
slices.summary: The final cue now remains full-opacity from terminal settlement through the accepted same-tick native release, while earlier scrubbing remains unpinned.

slices.title: Unify dark axis and divider token
slices.summary: Dark graph axes now consume the dark stage-divider token exactly; the light theme retains its independent black axis token.
